what: Photo and text cells sit in one horizontal strip inside a panel pinned to the screen, and the strip is pushed sideways by as much as you scroll down. The Section height is set by the strip’s overflow length (at least the screen height). As in the original, pushing starts the moment the Section’s top edge touches the bottom of the screen, and after scrolling the overflow length the strip reaches the last cell (tied directly to scroll position, no curve). It is measured again when the cell size changes.

options.start: If pin, pushing starts after the panel sticks to the screen (default is from when the section touches the bottom of the screen — original)
options.[data-fx-part=sticky]: Panel pinned to the screen (direct child just below the Section)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Horizontal strip in a row (inside sticky)
options.extra: Multiple of the screen height to add to the section height, default 0 — with start: pin, 1 pushes through to the last cell while the panel stays stuck (brand)
options.until: ”leave” pushes over the span until the section’s bottom edge leaves above the screen (section height + panel height) — the stuck panels must all pass before the last cell is reached (Brand usage flow). Default is the overflow length
options.rate: If “screen”, scrolling down one vertical screen pushes one horizontal screen — section height = Overflow / screen width × screen height + screen height (Brand: 500vw strip → 500vh section, start: pin)
options.min: Narrower than this width (px), it stops pushing and stacks the columns vertically (is-stack), none by default — Brand site 769

note: With reduced motion, panels open as a horizontal scroll instead of sticking

from.where: index.html .tb-hslide (photo·text·cactus strip after the hero) — original holiscroll.js: height = Sum of cell widths + left margin of the first cell − board width, start = Section offsetTop − panel height, scroller.scrollLeft = Length × progress (Lenis scroll value)
index.html .us-service (horizontal strip of four service cards) — start: pin · extra: 1, original height calc(100vh + strip width − 100vw)

index.js scrollHorizontal (usage flow — section height set to the strip overflow (px), panel held sticky, from when the section top touches the screen bottom until its bottom edge leaves the screen top, x = −overflow × progress. No curve, stays at the scroll position, progress bar wheel 2520°)

index.html .ow-wrap (original: #wrap 500vh · .sticky_wrap sticky 100vh · .horizontal_scroll 500vw translated by translate3d(−(scrollY−offsetTop)/innerHeight×100vw) 0~400vw, vertical plates below 768px) → start: pin; rate: screen; min: 769

about.html .mm-hscroll (original .horizontal_scroll: height = scroller overflow + sticky height, scrollLeft while rect.top ≤ 0 = −rect.top — 1:1 once stuck, on the phone version, instead of horizontal movement the cards stack with top 65px sticky)
